title.en: MALACAÑANG RESIDENCE OF THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES ORGANIZING A CERTAIN PORTION OF THE MUNICIPALITY OF SAN JOSE, PROVINCE OF ANTIQUE, INTO AN INDEPENDENT MUNICIPALITY UNDER THE NAME OF HAMTIC.

text.en:
- 2 -
The municipality of San Jose shall have its present
territory minus the portion thereof included in the
municipality of Hamtic.
The municipality of Hamtic shall begin to exist
upon the appointment and qualification of the mayor,
vice-mayor, and a majority of the councilors thereof,
and upon the certification hy the Secretary of Finance
or the Provincial Tre surer of Antique that said munic-
Ipality is financially capable of implementing the
provisions of the Minimum Wage Law and providing for
all the statutory obligations and ordinary essential
services of a regular municipality and that the mother
mun cipality of San Jose, after the serreration there-
from of the barrics comprised in the municinality of
Hamtic, can still maintain creditably its municipal
goverrment, meet all statutory obligations, and provide
for essential municipal services.
Done in the City of Manila, this 5th day of January,
in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty-four,
and of the Independence of the Philippines, the eighth.
(SGD.) RAMON MAGSAYSAY
Fresident of the Philippines
By the President:
(SGD.) FRED RUIZ CASTRO
Executive Secretary
